quotes.speaker: Kasparas Jakučionis
quotes.summary_phrase: Kasparas Jakučionis on his aggressive defensive play and foul trouble
quotes.excerpt: I'm an aggressive player. I always play that way and it's a little bit weird.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: Taylor was pretty effusive postgame. He's like, maybe Kasparas got his hand in the cookie jar on one, the foul down court. He's like, there's some 50-50 fouls early, but he wouldn't want you to not be that way. So I guess just what was the messaging when you are two fouls early, which is obviously you don't want, but he didn't seem that upset, I guess, with what you were trying to do defensively?

text_blocks.speaker: Kasparas Jakučionis
text_blocks.text: I would say it wasn't the smartest move for me, but I'm an aggressive player. I always play that way and it's a little bit weird because usually you get away with these calls because you just be aggressive over and over so they cannot call everything. But I think this preseason is to figure out some stuff too. So just got to be smarter for the next time. Be aggressive, but maybe a little bit smarter on that for sure.

quotes.social_post: Kasparas Jakučionis on his early foul trouble: It was not the smartest move for me but I am an aggressive player. I always play that way and I just have to be smarter for the next time.

quotes.speaker: Kasparas Jakučionis
quotes.summary_phrase: Kasparas Jakučionis on the difficulty of finding rhythm in preseason
quotes.excerpt: The rhythm was hard to find when you play one minute in first quarter.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: I know you've had one full season already, but was this still a little frustrating to have to sit as much as you did in the first half where you could maybe just couldn't get the kind of rhythm you wanted, which you found later, but to have to watch that unfold in the first half?

text_blocks.speaker: Kasparas Jakučionis
text_blocks.text: The rhythm was hard to find when you play one minute in first quarter and a couple minutes in second quarter. It's hard, hard to find the rhythm for sure. So that's why I said it's not the smartest fouls what I did. I had to be way smarter in that aspect, but it's a friendly game, it's an exhibition game, so that's why just keep learning from that and just be better next time.

quotes.social_post: Kasparas Jakučionis admits it is hard to find a rhythm in the preseason when you are in and out of the lineup due to foul trouble.

quotes.speaker: Kasparas Jakučionis
quotes.summary_phrase: Kasparas Jakučionis on balancing aggressive play with coaching expectations
quotes.excerpt: I feel like they like that I'm playing aggressive, trying to be that way.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: What do your coaches tell you about your style of play and I guess how you find that balance between being aggressive but not getting in trouble?

text_blocks.speaker: Kasparas Jakučionis
text_blocks.text: I feel like they like that I'm playing aggressive, trying to be that way and I think it's a good thing. But like I said, if you combine this plus a little bit more smarter, I think that's the best, that's the way to go. So I think I'll definitely not be passive now just because I got some fouls for sure. No, like I feel like I'm here to give my all out on the court every time, so I'll do the same just be a little bit smarter.

quotes.social_post: Kasparas Jakučionis says he will not change his aggressive style of play despite early foul issues: I feel like I am here to give my all out on the court every time so I will do the same just be a little bit smarter.

quotes.speaker: Kasparas Jakučionis
quotes.summary_phrase: Kasparas Jakučionis on his aggressive offensive approach and free throws
quotes.excerpt: Every game you trying to do what it gives you. You trying to take.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: On the other end though, I think 11 free throws. So do you feel like you got it back on the other side in terms of being aggressive offensively and getting to the free throw line?

text_blocks.speaker: Kasparas Jakučionis
text_blocks.text: If they called some fouls for me, so I was trying to be aggressive on the other end. So it worked out this game. Every game you trying to do what it gives you. You trying to take. One time maybe you need more like playmaking, other you need to be more aggressive going to the rim. So this I feel like there was a lot of fouls called on both ends, so I just tried to use it at my advantage on the other end on the floor.

quotes.social_post: Kasparas Jakučionis on drawing 11 free throws: Every game you are trying to do what it gives you. One time maybe you need more playmaking, other you need to be more aggressive going to the rim.

quotes.speaker: Kasparas Jakučionis
quotes.summary_phrase: Kasparas Jakučionis on team transition defense and turnover issues
quotes.excerpt: The transition defense was really bad in all the games we played so far.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: Now that you've gotten in a couple games, you've seen your teammates play a couple games, how have you seen some of that practice work translate a little bit and I guess what can be improved on as you go forward?

text_blocks.speaker: Kasparas Jakučionis
text_blocks.text: We're way far from where we should be and where we could be as a team. The transition defense was really bad in all the games we played so far. That's what we're trying to work on in practices, try to put a lot more attention on that aspect than today points of turnover. I think they scored like 41 points of turnovers. So that's really bad. But I feel like we have really good potential of moving forward and improving things and I really like how we approach things.

quotes.social_post: Kasparas Jakučionis says the Bucks are far from where they need to be, specifically citing poor transition defense and 41 points allowed off turnovers: We are way far from where we should be and where we could be as a team.
